title.zh-TW: 印度飢荒：乾旱還是政府沒儲糧
title.en: The Indian famine: drought or no grain reserves

subtitle.zh-TW: 兩種說法都有道理，差別在於把什麼當作常態（normality）。
subtitle.en: Both accounts are reasonable; they differ in what they take to be normal.

story.zh-TW: 考慮印度發生大飢荒的情境。當地的農民說，飢荒是乾旱造成的；世界糧食組織則說，飢荒是因為政府沒有儲備糧食。降雨稀少與政府不儲糧都是飢荒的必要條件，兩種說法各自強調其中一項。
story.en: Consider a great famine in India. The local farmers say that the drought caused it; an international food organisation says that it was caused by the government's failure to keep grain in reserve. Scant rainfall and the lack of reserves are each necessary for the famine to happen, and each account stresses one of them.

zh-TW.sentence: 當地的農民說，飢荒是乾旱造成的；
世界糧食組織則說，飢荒是因為政府沒有儲備糧食。

en.sentence: The local farmers say that the drought caused it;
an international food organisation says that it was caused by the government's failure to keep grain in reserve.

text.zh-TW: 農民把好天氣當作常態（normality），乾旱是異常，因此把飢荒歸因於乾旱。
text.en: The farmers take good weather to be normal and the drought to be the anomaly, and so blame the drought.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型依 Hart 與 Honoré 的例子擬成：FAM = DR·¬ST，乾旱發生而且政府沒有儲糧，才有飢荒。兩者都是 but-for 原因，分歧只在預設值（default value）。模型採世界糧食組織的預設：當地常年少雨（DR 預設為 1），政府本該儲糧（ST 預設為 1）。在這組預設下，引擎判 ST = 0 是原因，DR = 1 不是。農民的預設正好相反（DR、ST 預設皆為 0），改用這一組，結果對調。王鵬翔 (2019) 指出，天氣幾乎無法改變，儲糧卻是成本較低的干預（intervention），所以糧食組織的說法仍有理由。
explanation.en: The model is built from Hart and Honoré's example: FAM = DR·¬ST, so the famine occurs when drought occurs and the government keeps no reserves. The simple counterfactual test and the HP definitions count both as causes; the disagreement is about defaults. On the food organisation's view, scant rain is ordinary weather there (the default for DR is 1) and the government ought to hold reserves (the default for ST is 1), so the lack of reserves is the departure and the drought a background condition; with these defaults the engine makes ST = 0 a cause and DR = 1 not. The farmers' view is the reverse: good weather is normal (default DR = 0) and a government that keeps no reserves is only to be expected (default ST = 0); with those defaults the two verdicts swap (checked by recomputing). Wang (2019) points out that even if the farmers are right that drought is abnormal, changing the weather is practically impossible while keeping reserves is a cheaper intervention the government could take, so the organisation's account still has its reasons. A model holds one set of defaults, so the organisation's version is encoded here, and the farmers' judgment is the intuition shown; the two differ in the engine's comparison.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2019). The problems of counterfactual thinking in omissive causal judgements [in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 49(3), 287–340.

note.zh-TW: 此文第 318 頁轉述 Hart 與 Honoré (1985: 35–36) 的例子，第 319 頁分析農民與糧食組織的預設，第 328–329 頁談成本。Hart 與 Honoré 的書本身未查，所以頁碼 35–36 沒有核對。
note.en: The paper relays Hart and Honoré's (1985: 35–36) example on p. 318, analyses the farmers' and the organisation's defaults on p. 319, and turns to cost on pp. 328–329. Hart and Honoré's book itself was not consulted, so pp. 35–36 are unchecked.

verdicts.note: The organisation's defaults: scant rain is ordinary, reserves are expected.
With the farmers' defaults (DR = 0, ST = 0) the two verdicts swap.
